evals.name: version-bump-location
evals.prompt: I'm ready to cut a new release. Where should I update the version number?
evals.expected_output: The response must explicitly point to '[versions] app' in 'gradle/libs.versions.toml' as the single source of truth and warn against hand-editing 'versionCode' in build.gradle.kts.

evals.name: changelog-internal-rule
evals.prompt: I just added a new CI job for secret scanning. How should I record this in the changelog?
evals.expected_output: The response should mandate adding the entry under a '### Internal' heading in the '[Unreleased]' section so it's excluded from the in-app viewer.

evals.name: schema-modification-protocol
evals.prompt: I need to make a column nullable in an entity that was part of the v0.8.0 release. Can I just edit the @ColumnInfo in the Entity class?
evals.expected_output: The response must say NO. Since the version shipped in a release, its schema is frozen. It requires a database version bump and a tested Migration object.
